title: Contains Duplicate
constraints: Return a boolean and do not modify the input array.

examples.explanation: Duplicate detection works for negative values as well.

solutionApproaches.title: Compare Every Pair
solutionApproaches.explanation: Check each value against every later value. This is simple but inefficient for a large array.

solutionApproaches.title: Hash Set
solutionApproaches.explanation: Add each element to a set. If it already exists, return true.
